title: agrostis capillaris subsp. repens
intro: Agrostis capillaris subsp. repens, commonly known as creeping bent grass, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of creeping bent grass include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent and a natural remedy for digestive issues, such as diarrhea and ulcers. The bioactive constituents of Agrostis capillaris subsp. repens include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
